Several days (independent missions; part depends on the full moon and timers)

A curse turns the inhabitants of the island of {wiki:Grimvale|Grimvale} into were-creatures at every full moon, and the disease is spreading to Edron, Cormaya, the Darama desert and Oskayaat. This quest has four independent parts: **The Curse of the Full Moon** (access to the boss {creature:Feroxa}), **The Curse Spreads** ({item:Foxtail Amulet} and achievement **Over the Moon**), **An Ancient Feud** (achievement **Drama in Darama**, shortcuts to the {wiki:Lion Sanctum|Lion Sanctum} and trades with {npc:Domizian}) and **Paradise Lost** ({item:Toy Ball} to tame the Foxmouse, access to Oskayaat and a treasure chest).
A terrible curse turns the inhabitants of a small island northeast of Edron into dangerous were-creatures every full moon. Can you help them, or will you succumb to their horrible fate?
Cornell, ferry to Grimvale (north of Stonehome, Edron)
Money for travel (boats and ferries between Edron, Grimvale, Cormaya, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun and Oskayaat).
**The Curse Spreads**: {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest} done up to mission 3 (access to {wiki:Vengoth}).
**An Ancient Feud**: {wiki:Lion's Rock Quest} done until you have access to the temple.
**The Curse Spreads** (Corym Mines): access to the inside of the {wiki:Corym Mines} through the {wiki:Hidden Threats Quest} (you can start it right there).
for the nuggets in the Corym Mines and for the Silver Veins of Grimvale (Secret Agent Tools also work)
one for each silvered trap you want to make for Feroxa (280 gp, sold in equipment shops and by Gladys in Grimvale)
An Ancient Feud (you can take 5 from the Stump above the Lion's Rock entrance)
An Ancient Feud, bought from Halif in Darashia
An Ancient Feud, bought from Mugluf in Darashia
or Secret Agent Tools, Cleaver, Small Axe or Obsidian Knife (to cut the Lion's Mane Flower and the Dewberry Palm Leaf)
Paradise Lost (sacrifice), bought in tool shops
**The Curse of the Full Moon**: access to {creature:Feroxa}'s lair.
Use of the {item:Death Portal|Death Portals} between the Last Sanctum and the Edron cave (The Curse Spreads).
**Drama in Darama** achievement, shortcuts to the Lion Sanctum and trades with {npc:Domizian} (An Ancient Feud).

Access to the Foxmouse lair, to the {item:Treasure Chest (Oskayaat)} room (it can give {item:Werewolf Painting (Howling)} or {item:Werewolf Painting (Moon)}) and to the locked doors of Oskayaat, with NPCs and training statues (Paradise Lost).
Part **The Curse of the Full Moon**: after handing 3 {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} to {npc:Maeryn} and killing 50 were-creatures.
The lair opens on the **13th** of each month, when the raid starts.
Part **The Curse Spreads**: after the ritual in the Moonshadow Temple of Grimvale.
Death Portals between the Last Sanctum and the Edron dungeon
Part **The Curse Spreads**: when {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} gives you the {item:Foxtail Amulet}, after you kill the 5 mini-bosses.
Part **An Ancient Feud**: in {npc:Domizian}'s final reward (Lion Mosaics).
The door between the Sanctum and the Hyaena Lairs, and the statue on top of Lion's Rock that takes you to the Sanctum entrance.
Part **An Ancient Feud**: in {npc:Domizian}'s final reward, in Darashia.
Part **Paradise Lost**: after recovering the stolen {item:Ocarina} in the {wiki:Mother of Scarabs Lair|Mother of Scarabs Lair} and returning to {npc:Tonar}, in Ankrahmun.
Locked doors of Oskayaat (NPCs and training statues)
Part **Paradise Lost**: 20 hours after the ritual, when {npc:Niral} gives you the {item:Toy Ball}.
Foxmouse's lair and the Treasure Chest room (Oskayaat)
Part **Paradise Lost**, at the end (with {npc:Niral}'s {item:Toy Ball}).
The chest room is opened by using a {item:Moonlight Ipomea's Stamen} on the twines between the {item:Symbol of Fire} and the {item:Symbol of Sula (Silver)}.
Part **Paradise Lost**: use the {item:Toy Ball} on the Foxmouse to tame it.
Cursed characters cannot tame it: eat {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} first.
You need the parts **The Curse Spreads** and **An Ancient Feud**.
Together with the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest} up to mission 3, they give access to the boss {creature:Katex Blood Tongue}, requested in *Sweet Dreams*.
The four missions are **independent**: you can do The Curse Spreads, An Ancient Feud and Paradise Lost at any time, even without having done The Curse of the Full Moon.

**The Curse of the Full Moon** can only be done on full moon nights: from the {wiki:Server Save} on the **12th** to the server save on the **15th** of each month (when the {wiki:Grimvale Mini World Change} is active).

In **An Ancient Feud** you will have to kill 300 {creature:Werehyaena|Werehyaenas} and {creature:Werehyaena Shaman|Werehyaena Shamans}. The ones you kill from the start count, so kill them while exploring instead of running from them.
In **Paradise Lost**, start the instruments (the Scarab Ocarina takes 15 min to be ready) before the runes, so you do not have to wait.
Several steps only work at **night** in Tibia (A Skull, runes, sacrifice, shells and instruments in Oskayaat). Check the in-game time before you go.
This mission can only be done during the full moon (server save on the 12th until the server save on the 15th). The reward is access to Feroxa's lair, which opens on the 13th of each month.
Travel to **Edron** and walk to **Stonehome**. North of Stonehome is {npc:Cornell}'s ferry.

Say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and confirm to be taken to **Grimvale**. The trip costs **100 gp** ({npc:Cornell} also accepts {key:sail}) and you disembark at the **south** dock of Grimvale, near the village.

If you are bitten by a were-creature you end up turning into one. While you are transformed you **cannot leave the island** unless you die or teleport. To cure yourself, eat {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} (2nd floor of the dungeon) or wait for a day without a full moon.
Arrival: Cornell in the south of Grimvale
In the village of Grimvale talk to {npc:Maeryn}: say {key:hi}, {key:quest} and answer {key:yes}. She asks you for at least **3** {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} to cure the bitten villagers.
2. The Curse of the Full Moon: Purple Nightshade and 50 were-creatures
Enter the Grimvale dungeon by dropping through the {item:Pitfall} in the **northeast** of the island.
Way down to the Grimvale dungeon

From the start, go **south** and follow the cave to the **southeast**. In the next room is the first {item:Blooming Purple Nightshade}. Use it to pick the {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms}. You receive the message *"You pick the large blooming blossom from the stem of this purple nightshade."*
Go **west** to the end of the cave and go down the pitfall to the next floor. Walk **north** to the second flower and pick it.
Go **east** and follow the path to the **southeast** to the third flower and pick it.
Each spot has a **30-minute cooldown**. Outside the full moon you only see {item:Purple Nightshade} without a flower and you receive *"This purple nightshade is currently not blooming."*

To hand in the flowers you have to return to the surface: go back the opposite way through the floors you went down until you leave the dungeon (bring the {item:Rope}). {npc:Maeryn} is in a little house in the **southwest** of the village.
Go back to {npc:Maeryn} with the 3 {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} and say {key:nightshade}.

To enter Feroxa's lair you also have to kill **50 were-creatures** ({creature:Werebadger}, {creature:Werebear}, {creature:Wereboar}, {creature:Werewolf}, {creature:Werefox}…). The counter appears in your {wiki:Quest Log}.
3. The Curse of the Full Moon: silver traps and Feroxa
For the fight against Feroxa you need 20 {item:Closed Silvered Trap|Closed Silvered Traps} in total (for the whole server, not per player). Usually each player brings a few.
Buy {item:Closed Trap|Closed Traps} (280 gp each) in an equipment shop, for example from {npc:Gladys} in Grimvale.

Go to the **3rd floor** of the Grimvale dungeon and use a {item:Pick} (or {item:Secret Agent Tools}) on a {item:Silver Vein} in the mountain walls. It does not always work (about 16 successes in 60 attempts): if it fails you receive *"Even after a thorough and frustrating search you could not find enough liquified silver..."*, but you can try again on the same vein. When you succeed you receive a {item:Vial of Liquid Silver}, which lasts **24 hours**.
After each attempt you cannot mine again for **2 minutes**. The veins can only be mined during the **full moon**.

Each vial you obtain gives you permission to use one {item:Strangely Glowing Mark (Green)|green mark} (heals 250 HP) or one {item:Strangely Glowing Mark (Blue)|blue mark} (+90 speed for about 1 minute) on the 3rd floor.
Take the {item:Closed Trap} and the {item:Vial of Liquid Silver} to {npc:Maeryn}, say {key:trap} and then {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Closed Silvered Trap}. Repeat to make more traps.

With the 3 flowers handed in and the 50 were-creatures killed you have access to {creature:Feroxa}'s lair. The lair opens when the raid starts, on the **13th** of each month, at any time between the server save and 12 hours later. **The mission is completed as soon as you enter the lair**, even if you do not fight. The lair is behind a **teleport** on the deepest floor of the Grimvale dungeon (the same floor as the ruins, see coordinate).
The Curse of the Full Moon mission completed

1) Human form: attack normally (spells and physical attacks) until she is at half health.
2) She turns into {creature:Feroxa (Werewolf)}: she becomes immune to almost everything except the {item:Silvered Trap|silvered traps} and {wiki:Life Drain} damage. Place the traps on the ground: each time she steps on one she takes 1,000 damage and the trap disappears. You can stack them and she does not heal. Alternatively, sorcerers and druids can summon {creature:Gozzler|Gozzlers} or {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} (life drain damage), but it takes much longer.
3) At half health she becomes {creature:Feroxa (Killable Werewolf)}: attack with everything.
4) When she reaches 0 she turns into the weak human form or into {creature:Feroxa (Gloom Wolf)}; both are weak, finish them off.
You receive two sets of loot for the battle. Only the final form (Gloom Wolf) counts for the {wiki:Bosstiary}.

After the fight, go back the same way to the surface and go to the **south** dock of the island. Say {key:hi}, {key:sail} and {key:yes} to {npc:Cornell} (100 gp): he takes you back to **Edron**, to the dock north of Stonehome.
If you are bitten and transformed into a were-creature you **cannot leave the island** by boat: only by dying or teleporting. Eat {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} before going to {npc:Cornell}.
4. The Curse Spreads: the cure in Edron
Requires the Blood Brothers Quest up to mission 3 (access to Vengoth).
In **Edron** castle, talk to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}: {key:hi}, {key:curse} and {key:yes}. The Purple Nightshade only cured the inhabitants outside the city; he sends you to the Edron Magic Academy.

Go to the Ivory Towers ({wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}) and climb to the upper floors of the **northwest** tower up to {npc:Milos}. Say {key:hi} and {key:curse}. He tells you about ley lines and asks you to find his old notes.

Go back to {npc:Milos} and say {key:notes}. You receive {item:Crimson Nightshade Blossoms} and a {item:Stone Tablet with Ley Lines}. Now you need {item:Shadow Bite Berries}, {item:Gold Dust} and {item:Silver Dust}.

Go to the dungeon **southwest** of Edron (you have to enter the {item:Sewer Grate} inside the Edron Flats building to get to the other side). Inside there are all kinds of were-creatures. Go down to the **2nd floor**: there is a {item:Shadow Bite Plant} right next to the rope spot. Use it to pick the {item:Shadow Bite Berries}.
There is also a Shadow Bite Plant on the 2nd floor of the {wiki:Edron Earth Elemental Cave}.

Go back the same way: on the 2nd floor use the {item:Rope} on the rope spot next to the plant to go up, return to the entrance and pass through the {item:Sewer Grate} of the Edron Flats building again to get back to the city.
Get to the Venore Corym Cave

Take the boat to **Venore** (in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}, 40 gp). Leave Venore by the city's **east exit** and follow the swamp to the cave, which is inside a building: **go up the stairs** of the building and then **down the ladders** (that way you do not need a rope to get in).

Travel to the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave}. Inside, go down the hole to the **northeast**, then the next hole, go **south** and go down again. Then go to the **northwest** side of the cave and step into the teleport.
Entrance of the Venore Corym Cave

The nuggets just north of the teleport belong to the {creature:Corym Ratter}: do not steal them in front of him. You have to get your own inside the mine. If you do not have access to the inside yet, start the {wiki:Hidden Threats Quest}.
In the room to the **southeast** of the entrance you find {item:Gold Nugget (Object)|Gold Nuggets}. Use the {item:Pick} on them to mine them.

Go down the stairs to the **north** to the flower floor (talk to the {npc:Corym Servant} if you do not have access yet). The {item:Silver Nugget|Silver Nuggets} are in a room to the **southwest**. Use the Pick on them.

Go back to the teleport you came in by: it takes you back to the Venore Corym Cave. Climb up the same holes with the {item:Rope} and the ladders to the building in the swamp, and return to Venore by the east exit. To return to Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (40 gp).
If you have progressed far in the {wiki:Hidden Threats Quest}, when you leave through the teleport for the first time you have to face the mini-boss {creature:Cave Spider}.
Go back to the Edron academy. **Two floors below** Milos there is a {item:Wooden Grinder}. Use the nuggets on the grinder to obtain {item:Gold Dust} and {item:Silver Dust}.
Go to {npc:Sinclair}'s laboratory, in the central tower, and use the {item:Alchemical Apparatus} on the **north** side of the room. Use the ingredients in this order:
4: Shadow Bite Berries and the Nightshade Distillate is ready
Take the {item:Nightshade Distillate} to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} and say {key:potion}. He sends you to help {npc:Yoem} in Cormaya.
5. The Curse Spreads: the water of Cormaya

{wiki:Cormaya} is a small island south of **Edron**. On the boat to the **north** of Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You disembark at the **north** port of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}.

Travel to **Cormaya** and talk to {npc:Yoem} in the middle of the village: {key:hi}, {key:curse}. He suspects the groundwater is contaminated. To enter the {wiki:Last Sanctum} you first have to perform a ritual in the Grimvale dungeon.

Go back to Edron and ask {npc:Cornell} (north of Stonehome) for {key:passage} to Grimvale. To return from Cormaya to Edron, ask {npc:Pemaret} at the north port: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).
In Grimvale go down at the marked spot and then go down two more times to the **4th floor** of the dungeon. You are in the ruins; go to the central room, where there is a 5x5 lever puzzle.

Each lever moves the white tile that is south of it. Pull the levers until you form a **V** that starts at the top, as in the image. Then pull **any other lever**: you hear a *click*, a ray of light comes down from the ceiling and the white tiles go back up. The ritual is done.
V configuration: with the tiles like this, pull any lever and you hear *click*

Go back the same way to the surface (bring the {item:Rope}) and ask {npc:Cornell}, at the **south** dock of the island, {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:yes} to return to Edron. Then take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to Cormaya again ({key:cormaya}).

Go back to **Cormaya**. The {wiki:Last Sanctum} is behind a {item:Mystic Flame} in a dungeon **east** of the village. Inside there are were-creatures. Follow the cave to the **southwest** and go down the ramp.
Dungeon with the Mystic Flame (Last Sanctum)

Go to the room to the **north**, where there are statues. Approach the water until you receive the message *"The clean water changes as soon as it flows into the basin. Obviously this is the spot where Cormaya's water gets tainted."*

Go back the same way: go up the ramp, follow the cave to the **northeast** to the {item:Mystic Flame} and come out in the dungeon **east** of the village of Cormaya. {npc:Yoem} is in the middle of the village.
Go back to {npc:Yoem} and say {key:curse}. He sends you to ask the Edron mages for help.

Talk to {npc:Milos} in Edron and say {key:curse}. He explains that cursed statues are at the origin of the three ley lines that cross under Cormaya and gives you a {item:Golden Symbol of Suon}. To get to Edron, take {npc:Pemaret}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).

Go to the origin of each ley line (Krailos, Banuta and Vengoth) and use the {item:Golden Symbol of Suon} next to the {item:Dark Stone Totem}. You receive *"You remove the curse that was put on this statue."*
Where the Dark Stone Totem is
To the west, before the castle gate: {coord:32949,31489,6}
Removing the curse from the Banuta ley line totem
Krailos totem: getting there and back

Take a boat to **Krailos** in Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes}, 100 gp) or in Darashia ({npc:Petros}, 110 gp). You disembark next to {npc:Captain Pelagia}. The totem is **northeast** of the village. To go back, {npc:Captain Pelagia} takes you to {key:edron} (100 gp), {key:venore}, {key:darashia} or {key:oramond}.
Banuta totem: getting there and back

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). From Port Hope, cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **north/northeast** to {wiki:Banuta}, the city of the apes. The totem is inside the **southernmost** building of the city. To go back, take the route in reverse through the jungle to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat ({key:edron}, 150 gp).
Vengoth totem: getting there and back

Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Darashia, Ankrahmun or Thais). At the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate), talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}. The totem is **west** of the castle gate. To go back, talk to {npc:Harlow} again in the west of Vengoth: {key:yalahar} (50 gp).
You can only travel with Harlow after you have started mission 4 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}.
Go back to the Last Sanctum: the water is clean and you receive *"The water that flows into the basin stays fresh and clean now. Obviously the curse is lifted."*
The water of the Last Sanctum, now clean
Say {key:curse} to {npc:Yoem}. He thanks you and tells you to talk to Daniel Steelsoul again.
6. The Curse Spreads: the werebeast leaders
Talk to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} ({key:curse}). He asks you to kill the 5 leaders who are spreading the disease, hidden behind magical gates in the dungeons of Edron and Cormaya.

The bosses have to be fought **alone**, but they are relatively easy. Mages and paladins can use {item:Fire Wall Rune|Fire Wall Runes} to keep their distance. {creature:Bloodback}, {creature:Darkfang} and {creature:Sharpclaw} are in the **Edron** lycanthrope cave (entrance through the {item:Sewer Grate} of the Edron Flats building, {coord:33179,31922,7}); {creature:Black Vixen} and {creature:Shadowpelt} are in the **Cormaya** Last Sanctum (entrance through the {item:Mystic Flame} east of the village, {coord:33353,32000,7}). In both caves leave the same way you came in.

After killing all 5, go back to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} and tell him about the {key:curse}. You receive the {item:Foxtail Amulet} and can now travel between the Last Sanctum and the Edron dungeon through the {item:Death Portal|Death Portals} in the two caves.
{item:Foxtail Amulet}, **Over the Moon** achievement and use of the Death Portals
The mini-bosses can be fought again every **20 hours**; the Death Portals save a lot of walking.
Death Portal in the Edron dungeon
7. An Ancient Feud: investigate the Hyaena Lairs
Requires the Lion's Rock Quest up to temple access. Remember: the Werehyaenas and Werehyaena Shamans you kill from here on count towards the task of 300 kills.
In Edron, say {key:curse} and then {key:lion} to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}, and answer {key:yes}. He sends you to {npc:Domizian}, in Darashia.

In **Darashia**, {npc:Domizian} is on the 1st floor of the building just west of the boat. Say {key:hi} and {key:lion} (or {key:curse}). He asks you to investigate the {wiki:Hyaena Lairs}, whose entrance is north of the city, next to a large standing stone. To get to Darashia from Edron, take the boat to **Venore** ({npc:Captain Seahorse}, {key:venore}) and there the one of {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} (60 gp). You arrive at {npc:Petros}'s port.
Domizian, west of the Darashia boat
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Hyaena Lairs}, north of Darashia. The entrance is **north** of the city, next to a large standing stone; go down through it to the first underground floor.
Map of the Hyaena Lairs with the places to investigate
Go down to the **3rd floor**. Go **south**, where you find another hole to the **4th floor**.
Go **south** again and then **west**, to the big puddle. Walk next to it until you receive a message on the screen.
Go **east** until you find the stone pile with skulls. Walk next to it until you receive the message.
Skulls on a Stonepile (stone pile with skulls)
Go up the rope spot between the first two places and walk **north** and then **east**, to the blood-stained pagoda. Here too you should receive a message.
Go back to the 4th floor and go **south** to the NPC {npc:A Skull}. He only answers when it is **night** in Tibia. Say {key:hi}, {key:undead} and {key:leader}.

Go back the same way: climb up the rope spots with the {item:Rope} to the entrance next to the large stone, north of Darashia, and return to the city. {npc:Domizian} is on the 1st floor of the building just west of the boat.
Go back to Darashia and say {key:undead} to {npc:Domizian}. Then return to the Hyaena Lairs.
In the Hyaena Lairs, follow the path **south** and go down the hole to {npc:Rhargu}. Say {key:hi} and {key:curse}. She asks for food and gives you an {item:Empty Cask}.
Get a {item:Haunch of Boar}, which is looted from {creature:Boar|Boars}.
Use a {item:Hydra Egg} on the campfire in the Hyaena Lairs to obtain a {item:Hard-Boiled Hydra Egg}.
If you do not yet have 5 {item:Lion's Mane}, you can take 5 from the {item:Stump} above the Lion's Rock entrance.
Leave the Hyaena Lairs. In the central market of Darashia buy a {item:Net (Fishing)|Net} from {npc:Halif} and 5 {item:Salt} from {npc:Mugluf}.

Use the Net on {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} (for example in the Thais sewers; mages can summon and capture theirs). There is a **20%** chance of obtaining a {item:Cave Rat (Item)}. Use {item:Salt} on it to make a {item:Salted Cave Rat} and use it on the Cask to store it. Repeat until the cask has **5** Salted Cave Rats.
Failed attempt to capture a Cave Rat

Enter the Hyaena Lairs again through the stone north of Darashia and head **south** to {npc:Rhargu}'s hole. Go back to {npc:Rhargu}, say {key:curse} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Lit Torch (Quest)} to continue and the {item:Cask (Goblin Zombie)} as a reward. Then leave the same way with the {item:Rope}.
If you lose the torch, say {key:lost torch} to Rhargu.
9. An Ancient Feud: destroying the cursed shrine
Go back to the **Skulls on a Stonepile** and use the {item:Lit Torch (Quest)} on it. The attempt will fail: that is normal.
The first attempt to burn the shrine fails
In Darashia say {key:destroy} to {npc:Domizian}. He tells you to bless the torch at an altar in the Lion Sanctum and gives you the phrase to open the door.
Go to **Lion's Rock**, northwest of Darashia. Before entering the cave, go up the ramp above the entrance and pick up a {item:Lion's Mane Flower} from the ground.

Inside Lion's Rock go to the **3rd floor**, to the stairs that lead to the Lion Sanctum (if the door asks, say *The sun guides our hearts. The moon guards our dreams*). Go down and go to the room **southwest** of the stairs, with the mosaic floor.
Use {item:Secret Agent Tools}, a {item:Kitchen Knife}, a {item:Cleaver}, a {item:Small Axe} or an {item:Obsidian Knife} on the {item:Lion's Mane Flower} to obtain {item:Chopped Lion Mane Petals}.
Stand on the **northeast** mosaic tile and use the petals on the {item:Lit Torch (Quest)}. You receive a {item:Lit Torch (Sparkling)}.
If you are not on the right tile you receive a wrong-place message, the torch does not shine and you **lose the petals**.

Go back the same way: go up the Sanctum stairs to the 3rd floor of Lion's Rock and keep climbing to the entrance, northwest of Darashia. Then go **east** to the entrance of the Hyaena Lairs, north of the city.
Go back to the **Skulls on a Stonepile** in the Hyaena Lairs and use the blessed torch on it to break the link to the undead.
Say {key:curse} to {npc:Domizian}. Now he wants you to kill **300** {creature:Werehyaena|Werehyaenas} and {creature:Werehyaena Shaman|Werehyaena Shamans}.

The ones you have already killed count, so you may already be done. If not, go back to the Hyaena Lairs and hunt until you complete it. Track your progress in the {wiki:Quest Log}. Then talk to {npc:Domizian} again ({key:curse}).
10. An Ancient Feud: King Heliodor's forgiveness
Say {key:curse} to {npc:Domizian}. He reveals that he is an exiled werelion and gives you a {item:Lion Ring} to enter the lower part of the Lion Sanctum.
Go down to the lower floor of the Sanctum
Go back to the Lion Sanctum, **equip the {item:Lion Ring}** and use the {item:Lion Column} in the **southwest** corner to go down to the lower floor.
Lower floor of the Lion Sanctum
Use the {item:Slightly Feline Statue} on the **southeast** side of the Sanctum. You can now open the door to the boss room, to the **north**.

In the boss room there are 4 special slabs that teleport you to each boss. Kill all four and pick up the unique item from each one (it is **mandatory** to continue). They are only a little stronger than {creature:Werelion|Werelions}.

With the 4 items, go back to the {item:Slightly Feline Statue} and use it again. The items disappear and you gain access to the king. Walk onto the mosaic next to the statue to enter {npc:Heliodor}'s room.
Say {key:hi} and {key:curse} to {npc:Heliodor}. You gain the **Drama in Darama** achievement.
Go back the same way to the Lion's Rock entrance and from there to **Darashia** to talk to {npc:Domizian} (1st floor of the building west of the boat).

Go back to Darashia and say {key:curse} to {npc:Domizian}. You receive the {item:Lion Mosaic (Head)} and the {item:Lion Mosaic (Mane)}. From now on Domizian trades with you and you can use the two shortcuts to the Lion Sanctum: the door between the Sanctum and the Hyaena Lairs, and the statue on top of Lion's Rock, which takes you to the entrance of the Sanctum.
Shortcut statue on top of Lion's Rock
{item:Lion Mosaic (Head)}, {item:Lion Mosaic (Mane)}, trades with Domizian and shortcuts
In Darashia say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Domizian}. He tells you that the disease has also reached other areas and that you should talk to the ferryman {npc:Tonar} about {wiki:Oskayaat}.

Go to **Ankrahmun**, find {npc:Tonar} and ask him for {key:passage} to Oskayaat. He tells you his ocarina was stolen, and that the thieves hide the loot in caves north of Ankrahmun. From Darashia, {npc:Petros} takes you to Ankrahmun: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} (100 gp).

Go to the {wiki:Mother of Scarabs Lair}, go down **two floors** and use the sarcophagus a little to the **north** on that floor. You receive the {item:Ocarina}. The **north** entrance of the lair is in the desert north of Ankrahmun; there is a second entrance to the **south** (there you may have to dig a few times with the {item:Shovel}). To leave, climb up the same way to the entrance and return to Ankrahmun.
Mother of Scarabs Lair south entrance
The sarcophagus where you find the Ocarina

Go back to {npc:Tonar} in Ankrahmun and ask for {key:passage} again: this time he takes you to Oskayaat. You disembark at {npc:Tonar}'s boat in Oskayaat; that is where you return whenever you want to leave the island.
12. Paradise Lost: mosaics and moon symbols

Explore the island. There is a cave with {creature:Werepanther|Werepanthers}, {creature:Werecrocodile|Werecrocodiles} and {creature:Feral Werecrocodile|Feral Werecrocodiles} and another with {creature:Weretiger|Weretigers}, {creature:Cunning Werepanther|Cunning Werepanthers} and {creature:White Weretiger|White Weretigers}. In the second there is a purple {item:Fog Portal} that you cannot enter yet.

To open the Fog Portal, step on the **6 mosaics**: 1 in the Werecrocodile cave and the other 5 in the Weretiger cave. On each one you receive *"click! It seems that you have activated some kind of mechanism by stepping onto the floor mosaic here."* After stepping on all of them you can enter the Fog Portal.
Use the 5 moon symbols in order

The Fog Portal takes you to a floor with even more were-creatures. Use the **5 moon symbols** exactly in the order on the map (1 to 5). Each correct symbol gives *"The moon symbol clicks into place."*; the last one adds *"You hear another mechanism activating in the sealed room behind you."*
Do not use the same symbol twice: it counts as a wrong symbol in the sequence.

Go **northeast** and use the wall marked on the map to enter {npc:Niral}'s room. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. Niral can partially control the curse and asks you for help; she suggests you ask the werelions of Darashia.

To go to Darashia, go back the same way (through the {item:Fog Portal} and the cave) to the surface and go to {npc:Tonar}'s boat, which takes you back to **Ankrahmun**. From Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
The ritual has three parts: runes that spell "SUN AND MOON", a sacrifice and two sacred instruments. Start the instruments right away, because the Scarab Ocarina takes 15 minutes to be made.

Say {key:curse} to {npc:Domizian}. He explains the ritual: write "SUN AND MOON" with runes (King Heliodor knows more), play a scarab shell ocarina and a shell horn, and sacrifice a creature touched by the curse.
Go to the Lion Sanctum and say {key:runes} to {npc:Heliodor}. He tells you to take the {item:Heliodor's Scrolls} from a chest just to the **north**, in the room that explains the sacred runes.

Go back to Oskayaat and say {key:mission} to {npc:Niral}. She reads the writings and tells you to activate the runes on the surface, **at night**, in the right order. To return to Oskayaat, leave the Lion Sanctum the same way, take {npc:Petros}'s boat in Darashia to Ankrahmun ({key:ankrahmun}) and ask {npc:Tonar} for {key:passage} again.
On the surface of Oskayaat, at **night**, activate the runes exactly in this order (1 to 6) to spell "SUN AND MOON".
If you activate a rune out of order you have to start again from the first one.
Bring a normal {item:Lit Torch} (sold in tool shops). At **night**, use a special tool or a {item:Kitchen Knife} on one of the blue palm trees to cut a {item:Dewberry Palm Leaf}.
Cutting a Dewberry Palm Leaf from a blue palm tree
Go to the stone shrine next to the island's boat (where you stepped on the runes) and, still at **night**, use the leaf on the {item:Lit Torch} to complete the sacrifice.
Using the leaf on the Lit Torch at the stone shrine

In Oskayaat, say {key:scarab ocarina} to {npc:Tonar}. He makes it for you from an intact, clean scarab shell. Kill a {creature:Scarab}, loot the corpse (or take everything out of it), wait **5 minutes** until the corpse passes the first stage of decay (stops being slimy), pick the corpse up into your backpack and hand it to Tonar. Then you have to wait **15 minutes** for the {item:Scarab Ocarina}.
At **night**, use the blue shells of Oskayaat to obtain a {item:Conch Shell}. There are three locations:
Open the chest in Oskayaat to obtain the {item:Wooden Mouthpiece}. Use the mouthpiece on the shell to assemble the {item:Conch Shell Horn}.
At **night**, stand in front of the sandy stone shrine and use both instruments ({item:Scarab Ocarina} and {item:Conch Shell Horn}).
Playing the instruments in front of the stone shrine
Go back to {npc:Niral} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She thanks you and asks you to come back the next day.

After **20 hours**, talk to {npc:Niral} again ({key:mission}) about the state of the curse. It is under control and you receive the {item:Toy Ball}, as well as access to the locked doors of Oskayaat (NPCs and {wiki:Training School|training statues}).
{item:Toy Ball} and access to the locked doors of Oskayaat
Use the {item:Toy Ball} on the {wiki:Foxmouse (Mount)|Foxmouse} to tame it and gain the **Like Fox and Mouse** achievement.
The Foxmouse senses the curse even outside the full moon: cursed characters cannot tame it. Eat {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} first to get rid of the curse.
Foxmouse mount and **Like Fox and Mouse** achievement

In the area to the **north**, beyond the Foxmouse, use a {item:Moonlight Ipomea's Stamen} on the {item:Twines|twines} between the {item:Symbol of Fire} and the {item:Symbol of Sula (Silver)} to open a room with the {item:Treasure Chest (Oskayaat)}. The chest can give a {item:Werewolf Painting (Howling)}, a {item:Werewolf Painting (Moon)} or other items.
The {item:Moonlight Ipomea's Stamen} is **used up** when you use it.
When you are done, go to {npc:Tonar}'s boat in Oskayaat: he takes you back to **Ankrahmun**, where {npc:Captain Sinbeard} has boats to Darashia, Venore, Edron, Port Hope, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.

Mysteries still unsolved: in the ruins of Grimvale there are 5 intact {item:Wall Mirror|Wall Mirrors} that can be broken with a {item:Crowbar} or a melee weapon (only the ones facing east). On the 3rd floor there are many blue and green Strangely Glowing Marks that exist nowhere else.
The books *The Moonshadow Temple* and *Were-Transformation*, in Grimvale, are considered clues to the continuation of the quest.
Outside the full moon, NPCs react as if you were not sick, even if you have been bitten.
